class.name: MySQLAsyncOperation
class.brief_description: A pending asynchronous call: [method MySQLSession.async_execute_text], [method MySQLSession.async_execute_prepared], or a batch or close of an asynchronous [MySQLStreamingCursor].
class.description: Returned immediately by [method MySQLSession.async_execute_text], [method MySQLSession.async_execute_prepared], [method MySQLStreamingCursor.async_next_batch] and [method MySQLStreamingCursor.async_close], before the server has answered. Wait for it by awaiting [signal completed] only if [method is_finished] is still [code]false[/code] (otherwise read [method get_result] directly): [signal completed] fires only once, so if the operation already finished while something else was being awaited, a bare [code]await async_op.completed[/code] would never return. Alternatively, poll [method is_finished] across frames (driven by [method Object.call_deferred] under the hood, so it only progresses while the [SceneTree] is processing frames, never from a busy [code]while[/code] loop). Once finished, [method get_result] returns the same [MySQLResult] that [signal completed] carries.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Stops the operation if it is still running. Returns [code]false[/code] if there is nothing to cancel (the operation already finished, or was rejected because the session was busy), [code]true[/code] otherwise; calling it again does nothing more. The operation still finishes through [signal completed]. First, a short-lived side connection with the same [MySQLConfig] runs [code]KILL QUERY[/code] on the operation's connection: the operation then fails with the server's non-fatal "Query execution was interrupted" error, and the session stays connected. Some functions return early instead of failing when interrupted ([code]SLEEP()[/code] returns [code]1[/code]), and a query that was already done finishes with its full result. If the side connection cannot connect or run the [code]KILL[/code] within [member MySQLConfig.cancel_timeout_ms], the operation is cancelled locally instead: it fails with a fatal error, and the connection is dropped ([method MySQLSession.is_db_connected] returns [code]false[/code] until [method MySQLSession.connect_db]). The query may keep running on the server until it finishes.

method.name: get_result
method.description: The [MySQLResult] of this operation, or [code]null[/code] if it has not finished yet (check [method is_finished] first).

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once [signal completed] has fired and [method get_result] is available.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once, when the operation finishes (successfully or not), and never again. [code]result[/code] is the same [MySQLResult] [method get_result] then returns. Check [method is_finished] before awaiting it (see the class description).
